instruction: Using the opened Graphisoft/Archicad environment and the official Graphisoft/Archicad command-line or automation interfaces available in the environment, complete the model work from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and save the finished deliverable as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. Before starting the work, invoke Archicad from `C:\Program Files\GRAPHISOFT\Archicad 27\Archicad.exe` when running the automation. Do not create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process the IFC file outside the Graphisoft/Archicad toolchain. The current model is a two-level kindergarten with classrooms, play hall, staff areas, toilets, and a simple roof. The operator needs a sensory support room and a parent meeting room identified for the next licensing submission, while the stair, roof, and classroom clusters remain stable. Add the rooms and their access/daylight records so staff can manage quieter child support activities separately from general teaching. Deterministic evaluation contract: the identifiers, counts, relationships, properties, and numeric ranges in the following JSON are explicit task requirements: {"annotations":[{"class":"IfcSpace","name":"PLAY-HALL","tokens":["SENSORY SUPPORT ACCESS","CHILD ROUTE","LICENSING"]},{"class":"IfcSpace","name":"STAFF","tokens":["PARENT MEETING","STAFF SUPPORT","LICENSING"]}],"products":[{"class":"IfcSpace","name":"SENSORY-ROOM","predefined":"INTERNAL","storey":"Ground Floor","tokens":["SENSORY ROOM","LOW STIMULUS","CHILD SUPPORT","QUIET"]},{"class":"IfcSpace","name":"PARENT-MEETING","predefined":"INTERNAL","storey":"Level 1","tokens":["PARENT MEETING","STAFF SUPPORT","PRIVATE","LICENSING"]},{"class":"IfcDoor","name":"SENSORY-ROOM-DOOR","predefined":"DOOR","storey":"Ground Floor","tokens":["SENSORY ROOM","CONTROLLED ACCESS","CHILD SUPPORT","DOOR"]},{"class":"IfcWindow","name":"PARENT-MEETING-WINDOW","predefined":"WINDOW","storey":"Level 1","tokens":["PARENT MEETING","DAYLIGHT","PRIVACY","STAFF"]}]}.
